clubs.tacticsWhy: FotMob 2026/27: 58.9% possession (4th), 466.5 accurate passes per match (3rd), and the fewest accurate long balls in the league (15.8 per match, about 3.4% of passes), so passing is very short. They have 4.8 possession wins in the final third per match (5th). At Old Trafford De Zerbi's high press set the tone, with 63 sprints to 44, 58% possession and 0.96 xG to 0.05 in the first half (The False 9). Analysis describes man-to-man pressing and patient 'press-baiting' build-up before quick releases, so tempo is set to 2. Sávio and Kudus pinned United's full-backs and stretched the pitch, and they make 4.7 accurate crosses per match (7th). Line=4 is inferred from the high press; no line-height data was found.
